'''Ghazhak''', along with his clan-brother [[Kohvrekhar]], was one of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] bodyguards. After the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] between Vader and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the two Noghri were tasked with locating Luke's lost [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and severed hand. After finding both in the possession of a group of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], Vader himself relieved the creatures of their prize and the Noghri accompanied him to [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] to deliver the items to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
